content.short: Stablecoin payments across African markets, including AI agents that pay M-Pesa bills for you.
content.description: Pretium lets people and businesses pay with stablecoins and have the recipient receive local money instantly, to mobile money, paybills or bank accounts, in more than seven African markets. Its newest feature lets users register an AI agent through MCP or REST and give it spending limits, so it can pay bills and invoices on their behalf. It has processed over $12 million across 54,000 wallets.
content.meta: Pay with stablecoins into mobile money and banks across Africa with Pretium, or let an AI agent pay within set limits.
